
```jsx
import { CxBreadcrumbItem } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxBreadcrumbItem from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/breadcrumb/CxBreadcrumbItem'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **active** | Toggle the active state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **href** | The `href` attribute for the inner `<CxLink>` component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
